author: Yffe
content: Fix (single file thermite-lower/src/lower.rs): generalize is_adt_fold_sum from a literal-0-base shape-fit to a STRUCTURAL recursive-fold predicate. The nat-return coercion (lower_spec_fn_ret) gated on has_unit_zero (a unit-variant base arm whose body is IntLit 0), so the GROUNDED Tree fold's value-carrying base (Leaf(v) => v as u64) was missed -> lowered -> u64 -> recursive arm tree_sum(*l)+tree_sum(*r) int-typed -> verus E0308 incompatible match arms. New detection: the match has at least one arm that recurses through a Box-deref'd field (f(*x)), with NO base-arm literal requirement; expr_has_deref_call_arg now walks the full arm-body expression tree (so Node(l,r)=>f(*l)+f(*r) and Cons(h,t)=>h as T+f(*t) both match). The nat return then coerces every arm uniformly (Cast -> as nat). sum_list/len (literal-0 base) unchanged; tree_sum now verifies 1 verified, 0 errors. Authority: .design/basis/01-adts.md REQ-10 + recorded structural-recursion finding; goal.md R-DEFER-9.
